Help
TOP QUESTIONS
How do I cancel my membership?
You can visit the subscription management page
to cancel your membership.
Manage subscription
How do I reset my password?
You can reset your password from inside the app.
Before doing so, it might help to add no-
reply@delevateapp.com to your address book to
decrease the chances of the password reset
email going to spam.
To reset your password, please open Elevate and
follow these steps:
1. If currently logged out, tap "Log in"
2. Tap "Add another account"
3. Tap "Log in"
• If a sign-in popup comes up, tap
"Cancel"
4. Tap "Continue with email"
5. Tap "Forgotten password"
